2024-untold-hope-solo-vs-u-s-soccer.synopsis: تبوح بطلة العالم "هوب سولو" بخبايا صعودها المضطرب إلى قمة كرة القدم النسائية وسط فضائح علنية وتوترات بين زميلاتها السابقات في الفريق.

untamed-royals-2024.title: Untamed Royals
untamed-royals-2024.synopsis: ترتكب مجموعة من المراهقين الأثرياء جرائم تتطور من مجرد حماقات تافهة إلى مخططات خطرة تسبب عواقب وتبعات فوضوية... لكنها لا تؤثر عليهم.

ash-and-bone-2022.title: Ash and Bone
ash-and-bone-2022.synopsis: The film follows a rebellious teen named Cassie Vanderbilt, whose wild streak escalates as her caring father Lucas decides to take her and his new wife Sarah out of the city for some bonding and quality time together. But after Cassie crosses the infamous McKinley family, it becomes clear that sometimes danger lies hidden in the weeds, ready to strike at any moment.

my-wife-s-hidden-lover-2023.title: My Wife’s Hidden Lover
my-wife-s-hidden-lover-2023.synopsis: An unhappy wife convinces her lover to move into her attic. But when she finds him dead, she becomes convinced that her unsuspecting husband found out and is keeping his knowledge of her affair a secret to mentally torture her. Does he know the truth? Or is someone else responsible for her lover’s death?
